description: Sappy audio engine command handler discovered through disasm analysis at ROM offset 0x079668.
notes: Sappy audio engine command handler. Function at 0x08079668 processes audio commands based on the low byte of R0. Commands 0x64-0x67 are special commands that load from specific offsets in a data structure. Commands 0x80-0xE3 are indexed commands. The function is called from battle event handlers (0x07EFFD, 0x07F065, 0x07F149). Audio table at 0x53F138 contains 88 entries × u32 pointer to Sappy audio data.
verification_method: Disasm analysis - found Sappy audio command handler that processes different audio commands based on input value.
discovered_by: Disasm trace of battle event handler code
